strongest_counterexample: Measured hem clearance repairs one concrete assumption but does not establish believable clothing, crown placement, hands or same-film character quality. If native support or visual review fails, preserve the failure at the limit rather than reclassifying it as technical bookkeeping or asking the Director to approve an algorithm.
